notes:
Call, Screen Share & Presence Fixes

  • No more audio echo on screen share. Sharing a screen no longer doubles voices into an echo.
  • The app no longer gets lost. Switching apps during a full-screen call won't make Remote disappear from the Dock -- click the Dock icon or Cmd-Tab to bring the call back.
  • Offline teammates look offline. People who are offline no longer show as "in meeting" or display calendar/app status.
  • Accurate shared-screen cursor. The pointer teammates see now lines up with where you're actually pointing, and your own cursor is no longer echoed to viewers.
  • No stray "Call ended" flash. Entering full-screen projection no longer flashes a "Call ended" badge.
  • Take over screen sharing. If someone is already sharing, you can now take over with a quick confirmation instead of asking them to stop first.
